question: The middle book is 17, smaller than 21. Which part of the shelf can be ruled out?
context: The search covers positions 0 to 6; the middle, position 3, holds 17.

choices.label: Positions 0 to 3: the middle and everything left of it
choices.feedback: Right. Every book up to position 3 is 17 or less, so 21 cannot be there. The search continues on positions 4 to 6.

choices.label: Positions 3 to 6
choices.feedback: Those are the books larger than 17, which is exactly where 21 must be.

choices.label: Only position 3
choices.feedback: Ruling out just the middle wastes the comparison. Because the shelf is sorted, everything left of 17 is smaller too.
